about: Hand-kept from the runner's logs (atom4-data runs/<run>/<group>/*.log). Plane-wave DFT, the book's exchange-only LDA, soft pseudopotentials, ecut 25 Ha. Energies in eV per formula unit Bl2Px3. Provisional until the relaxations finish.
status: relax-3 running. The volume minimum is bracketed, near ×1.033 for both cells. At 4 k, z2-0 is lower there by 0.16 eV a formula. Denser k (a14, a14s, which agree to 0.01) widened the unrelaxed difference from 0.11 to 0.40, so the estimate at the relaxed minimum is about 0.45: just past the 0.41 bar, but estimated, not measured. relax-3 measures it on the relaxed structures. Until then the cells stay unranked, with z2-0 favoured

relaxed.note: relax-1 and relax-2, 2x2x1x2 shifted k (4 k), ions relaxed at a fixed cell shape; fits through the points put both minima near x1.033 (z2-0 −1969.22 to −1969.23, z2-1 −1969.05 to −1969.08)

kLadder.note: unrelaxed x1.00 single points: how far sampling still moves the energy

gaps.note: bands-2: SCF grid plus a 10-point path, x1.00 unrelaxed, a10 k; this functional sits about 2.8 eV under measured gaps in ours (corundum: 6.02 against 8.8), so add +2.8 eV or scale x1.47
